content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Patna Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Patna Recruitment 2026 is September 5, 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by IIT Patna for the posts of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Project Assistant (PA) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: For the SRF post, candidates need an M Tech/MSc/ME/B Tech-M Tech Dual degree in relevant engineering fields with experience, or a B.Tech in Civil Engineering with 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (PA) position?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant (PA) position offers a salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month plus HRA. This is a contractual role at IIT Patna.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the IIT Patna Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced in this IIT Patna recruitment is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial email application with necessary documents, followed by shortlisting of candidates, and finally an online interview to assess suitability for the roles.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for the IIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply via email by sending their complete application along with all required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Patna offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, IIT Patna offers age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD candidates as per the prevailing rules and regulations of the Government of India.
